physical_writer_rule.current_state: no event writer active; reservation only
excluded_parallel_writers: any agent or human not named in the active phase
physical_writer_rule.conflict_check: Before every phase, require the previous phase release receipt, unchanged bound identities, unchanged origin, and no unallowed dirty or staged paths.

serialized_phases.starts: after separate baseline-publication approval and a passing task-58 preflight
serialized_phases.expires: on verified publication plus event-authority-activation receipt, or immediately on drift
serialized_phases.allowed_paths: the separately approved preparation manifest only
serialized_phases.release_condition: HEAD equals fetched origin/main, publication and activation receipts verify, the index is empty, and the lease release is recorded

serialized_phases.starts: after preparation release, authority activation, P0, and immediately before immutable T0 dispatch
serialized_phases.expires: at accepted canonical validation, hard blocker, authority invalidation, or T+30:00
serialized_phases.allowed_paths: child implementation/lifecycle paths and the canonical validation paths in event-allowlist.json, excluding staging, commit, and push
serialized_phases.release_condition: accepted canonical validation receipt or hard-blocker receipt

serialized_phases.starts: after the timed writer releases at accepted canonical validation and range preflight passes
serialized_phases.expires: after bounded commit, one normal non-force push, and publication receipt, or immediately on drift
serialized_phases.release_condition: normal push receipt or hard-blocker receipt; no writer overlap

serialized_phases.starts: after root integration owner publication release
serialized_phases.expires: at T+30:00 or earlier authority invalidation
serialized_phases.allowed_paths: local evidence-only receipts; public routes and existing provider state are read-only

serialized_phases.starts: after reveal selection and timed writer release
serialized_phases.expires: after bundle and root projection verification
serialized_phases.allowed_paths: the policy-listed local evidence, bundle, and root projection paths only

handoffs.canonical_test: codex records accepted canonical validation and releases before root-integration-owner stages anything
handoffs.publication: root-integration-owner records its claim, rechecks the exact range and origin, publishes, records release, then yields
handoffs.verification: codex resumes only after the publication release and performs provider/route checks read-only

heartbeat_and_renewal.heartbeat: record at phase claim, every mutation boundary, every retry, and phase release
heartbeat_and_renewal.renewal: allowed only before expiry when all bound hashes, owner, origin, index, and dirty-path checks still match

invalidation: any bound identity, allowlist, authority, owner, origin, branch, remote, or lease field changes
parallel source or Git writer activity
an owner fails to release before the next owner claims
the repair or deadline policy is exhausted
child_boundary: The child may execute a later activated authority but may not edit the run binding, immutable seal, authority reference, allowlist, lease, human approval, or validity window.

requires: Task 33 event-authority.json is explicitly human accepted
Goal 6 readiness tests and checkpoint pass
Task 58 publishes the separately approved preparation baseline
